cards.originalTitle: FinCutBench: A Continually Updated Benchmark for Measuring the Temporal Boundaries of LLM Financial Knowledge
cards.titleEn: FinCutBench Measures the Temporal Boundaries of LLM Financial Knowledge
cards.summaryEn: The study notes that point-in-time financial tasks can restrict external input dates, yet model parameters may retain financial facts disclosed later, creating parametric look-ahead bias. The authors build FinCutBench to measure the calendar boundary of a fixed model's financial knowledge monthly and report a reproducible date estimate via the FinCut Boundary. They report that boundary dates and localization precision vary across models, and that U.S. asset-ranking and earnings-recall performance show relative declines; these are the authors' findings and interpretations based on their measurement method.
cards.summary: 研究指出，金融回测等时点任务虽可限制外部输入日期，但模型参数可能保留更晚披露的金融事实，形成参数化前视偏差。作者构建 FinCutBench，按月测量固定模型金融知识的日历边界，并以 FinCut Boundary 给出可重复的日期估计。作者报告不同模型的边界日期与定位精度存在差异，并称下游资产排序与财报回忆任务出现相对下降；这些属于作者基于其测量方法的发现与解释。
keyPointsEn: The benchmark currently contains 9,000 Chinese and English four-option financial questions from January 2023 to September 2026, covering Chinese and U.S. markets and four categories of financial information.

The method constructs monthly knowledge profiles using approximate public-disclosure months; after a decline test and knot checks, it defines the FinCut Boundary as the first month when the fitted profile reaches its lower level and reports the stability of the estimated date under resampling.

The authors find boundary dates and localization precision vary by model, and report that when independently measured Transition Start and Boundary are used as references for downstream sample grouping, Sol and Luna show significant relative declines in U.S. asset ranking and earnings recall, with downstream effects varying by market and task.
cards.limitations: 证据仅覆盖作者构建的9000道中英文题目及2023年1月至2026年9月的时间范围，边界估计依赖“事实公开的大致月份”和拟合画像方法，题目选择与分类可能影响结果。文中结论关于下游表现下降，限于其设定的样本分组与任务，不能外推为所有市场、任务或模型的普遍规律；边界日期也不是精确的知识截止日。
cards.whyItMattersEn: In financial point-in-time evaluation and backtesting, ignoring facts disclosed later that may reside in model parameters can overstate evaluation results. The benchmark offers a monthly-updated measurement framework and empirical boundary to help select evaluation windows, interpret results, and identify parametric look-ahead bias; it is not investment advice or a basis for model ranking.
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence covers only the authors' 9,000 Chinese and English questions and the period from January 2023 to September 2026, and boundary estimates depend on approximate public-disclosure months and the fitted-profile method, so question selection and categorization may affect results. The reported downstream performance declines are limited to the specified sample groupings and tasks and cannot be generalized to all markets, tasks, or models; the boundary date is not a precise knowledge cutoff date.
cards.descriptionEn: The study introduces a monthly-updated financial knowledge benchmark with 9,000 Chinese and English four-option questions, designed to measure how far a fixed model's parametric financial knowledge extends over calendar time. Its novelty lies in constructing monthly knowledge profiles by public disclosure month and defining the FinCut Boundary as the first month when the fitted profile reaches its lower level; it is useful for identifying parametric look-ahead bias, selecting
cards.description: 该研究提出按月更新、当前含9000道中英文四选一题目的金融知识基准，用于测量固定模型参数中的金融事实知识在日历时间上延伸到何处。其新意在于用公开时间构造月度知识画像，并将拟合曲线进入低位的首个月定义为 FinCut Boundary；有用于 point-in-time 金融评测中识别参数化前视偏差、选择评测窗口和解释结果。
cards.whyItMatters: 对金融时点评测与回测而言，若忽略参数中可能包含的后续披露事实，评测结果可能被高估。该基准提供按月更新的测量框架和经验边界，可辅助选择评测窗口、解释结果并识别参数化前视偏差，但它不是投资建议或模型排名依据。
cards.title: FinCutBench 衡量大模型金融知识的时间边界
keyPoints: 基准当前含2023年1月至2026年9月的中英文四选一金融题共9000道，覆盖中国市场与美国市场及四类金融信息。
方法论用事实公开的大致月份构造月度知识画像，经下降检验和节点检查后，将拟合画像到达低位的首个月定义为 FinCut Boundary，并报告重采样下估计日期的稳定性。
作者发现边界日期和定位精度因模型而异，并称以独立的 Transition Start 与 Boundary 作为下游样本分组参照时，Sol 与 Luna 在美国资产排序和财报回忆上出现显著相对下降，且下游效应随市场与任务而异。

cards.originalTitle: Deep Personalization: Continuous Context Observation for Local Proactive Agents
cards.titleEn: Deep Personalization for Local Proactive Agents via Continuous Context Observation
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes deep personalization, a closed-loop process linking continuous context observation with continual agent adaptation, implemented in Coco, a proactive desktop agent. Coco uses a separate Observer Agent to monitor desktop activity, maintain compact long-term user modeling context, and learn when assistance is desirable from implicit signals such as engagement, dismissal, explicit requests, and repeated work patterns. The authors also develop efficient on-device strategies so the Observer Agent can run locally without streaming raw activity data off-device; on the synthetic OSWorld-Persona benchmark, deep personalization improves macro F1 across three model backbones from 0.12-0.19 under direct prompting to 0.35-0.48 after adaptation. The authors' view is that on-device deep personalization can make proactive agents more timely and increasingly aligned with each user's everyday work.
cards.summary: 论文提出深度个性化，将连续上下文观察与智能体持续适应连接成闭环，并以Coco桌面主动智能体实现。Coco由独立Observer Agent监测桌面活动、维护紧凑长期用户模型，并从参与、忽略、显式请求和重复工作模式等隐式信号中学习何时提供帮助。作者还设计本地高效运行策略，避免原始活动数据离开设备；在合成基准OSWorld-Persona上，深度个性化将三个模型骨干的宏F1从直接提示的0.12-0.19提升至适应后的0.35-0.48。作者观点是，本地深度个性化可使主动智能体更及时、更贴合每个用户的日常工作。
keyPointsEn: Closed-loop deep personalization: the Observer Agent continuously observes desktop activity, selectively retains long-term context, and continually adapts intervention decisions from implicit feedback.
Privacy-preserving design: the Observer Agent can run on local AI compute platforms without streaming raw activity data off-device.

Evaluation approach: the OSWorld-Persona synthetic benchmark transforms existing computer-use trajectories into persona-conditioned intervention labels; macro F1 rises from 0.12-0.19 to 0.35-0.48 across three model backbones.
cards.limitations: 证据边界明确：OSWorld-Persona为合成基准，其标签来自现有计算机使用轨迹的转化，不能完全代表真实用户活动分布；周用户研究仅观察Coco将宏平均F1从0.199提升至0.515，样本规模、用户多样性和长期效果未在摘要中说明；本地运行策略的能耗、延迟和跨平台泛化性未给出量化证据；结论不应被解读为投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The key to proactive agents is offering help at the right time rather than being disruptive; this work combines intervention-timing learning with local continuous observation and provides a scalable evaluation path that avoids real sensitive data, offering a reference for privacy-friendly deployment of personalized proactive agents.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries are explicit: OSWorld-Persona is a synthetic benchmark whose labels are derived from transformed existing computer-use trajectories and cannot fully represent real user activity distributions; the week-long user study only observes Coco improving macro-averaged F1 from 0.199 to 0.515, with sample size, user diversity, and long-term effects not specified in the abstract; quantitative evidence on energy, latency, and cross-platform generalization of the on-device strategies is not provided; conclusions should not be interpreted as investment advice.
cards.descriptionEn: Introduces a closed-loop 'deep personalization' process that connects continuous desktop context observation with continual agent adaptation, enabling a local proactive agent to learn intervention timing from implicit feedback; also builds the synthetic OSWorld-Persona benchmark to avoid collecting sensitive real-user data and validates improved intervention decisions in a user study.
cards.description: 提出“深度个性化”闭环，让本地主动智能体通过持续观察用户桌面活动、选择性保留长期上下文，并从隐式反馈中学习干预时机；同时构建OSWorld-Persona合成基准，避免收集真实敏感数据，并在用户研究中验证了干预判断的改善。
cards.whyItMatters: 主动智能体的关键在于在合适时机提供帮助而非打扰；该工作将干预时机学习与本地持续观察结合，并给出无需真实敏感数据的规模化评估路径，为个性化主动智能体的隐私友好部署提供参考。
cards.title: 桌面主动智能体的深度个性化：持续观察与本地适应
keyPoints: 深度个性化闭环：Observer Agent持续观察桌面活动，选择性保留长期上下文，并从隐式反馈中持续调整干预决策。
隐私保护设计：Observer Agent可在本地AI计算平台运行，不将原始活动数据流式传出设备。
评估方式：构建OSWorld-Persona合成基准，将现有计算机使用轨迹转化为带人格条件干预标签的数据；在三个模型骨干上宏F1从0.12-0.19升至0.35-0.48。

cards.originalTitle: Train on prefill, monitor at decode: Using sparse autoencoders for topic monitoring
cards.titleEn: Prefill-Trained Sparse Autoencoder Features Enable Decode-Time Topic Monitoring
cards.summaryEn: Fact: The authors trained three detector architectures on synthetic multi-topic conversations covering seven topics and showed that, on Gemma-3 1B and 4B, monitors trained on features from prefill hidden states generalize to decoding; classifiers are robust to perturbations such as off-topic asides, topic removal, or section reordering, losing at most 5 macro-F1 points. Author's view: Ablations indicate that classifiers reaching baseline performance without SAE are several times larger, so compact topic monitors can be trained inexpensively during prefill and deployed during generation; SAEs are useful beyond safety classification.
cards.summary: 事实：作者训练了三种检测器架构，在覆盖七个主题的合成多主题对话上，于Gemma-3 1B和4B模型上验证了从预填充隐藏状态提取的特征训练的监控器能泛化到解码阶段；分类器对插入离题内容、移除主题或重排段落等扰动具有鲁棒性，性能最多下降5个宏F1点。作者观点：消融实验表明，不使用SAE时达到基线性能的分类器尺寸要大数倍，因此紧凑主题监控器可在预填充阶段低成本训练并在生成阶段部署；SAE在安全分类之外也有用途。
keyPointsEn: TopicScope trains causal topic classifiers on SAE features to assign a topic label to each token, allowing labels to change mid-response.
On Gemma-3 1B and 4B, monitors trained on prefill hidden states generalize to decoding and are robust to perturbations like off-topic asides, topic removal, or section reordering (≤5 macro-F1 drop).
Ablations show that classifiers reaching baseline performance without SAE are several times larger, indicating SAE features help build compact monitors.
cards.limitations: 实验基于合成多主题对话和七个主题，监控器在真实场景中的泛化能力未经验证；仅在Gemma-3 1B和4B模型上评估，其他模型架构的适用性未知；鲁棒性测试限于三种扰动类型，更复杂的分布偏移可能影响性能；未涉及监控器在量化交易等金融场景的直接影响。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work shows that topic monitors can be trained cheaply before generation and deployed in real time during generation, offering a feasible approach for fine-grained monitoring in multi-topic conversations. It also extends SAE applications beyond safety classification, providing a reference for model behavior monitoring and feature utilization in AI quantitative research.
cards.limitationsEn: Experiments rely on synthetic multi-topic conversations and seven topics; generalization to real-world scenarios is unverified. Evaluation is limited to Gemma-3 1B and 4B, so applicability to other model architectures is unknown. Robustness testing covers only three perturbation types; more complex distribution shifts may affect performance. The direct impact on financial scenarios such as quantitative trading is not addressed.
cards.descriptionEn: The study introduces TopicScope, a framework that trains causal topic classifiers on sparse autoencoder (SAE) features during prefill to assign a topic label to every token during generation, allowing topic changes mid-response. This extends topic monitoring beyond safety classification to multi-topic tracking, with low training cost and flexible deployment.
cards.description: 该研究提出TopicScope框架，利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征在预填充阶段训练因果主题分类器，使其能够在生成阶段对每个token进行主题标注，并允许主题在响应中途变化。新方法将主题监控从安全分类扩展到多主题追踪，且监控器训练成本低、部署灵活。
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作表明主题监控器可以在生成前低成本训练，并在生成时实时部署，为多主题对话的细粒度监控提供了可行方案；同时拓展了SAE在安全分类之外的应用场景，对AI量化研究中模型行为监控与特征利用具有参考价值。
cards.title: 基于SAE特征的预填充训练实现生成时主题监控
keyPoints: TopicScope框架在SAE特征上训练因果主题分类器，为每个token分配主题标签，支持标签在响应中途变化。
在Gemma-3 1B和4B上，预填充隐藏状态训练的监控器能泛化到解码阶段，且对插入离题、移除主题或重排段落等扰动鲁棒（宏F1下降≤5）。
消融显示，不使用SAE时达到基线性能的分类器尺寸大数倍，表明SAE特征有助于实现紧凑监控器。

cards.originalTitle: OptiMind: Improving Small Language Models for Optimization Modeling through Formulation Guidance and Multi-Turn Learning
cards.titleEn: OptiMind: Improving Small Language Models for Optimization Modeling with Hint Libraries and Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
cards.summaryEn: Mathematical optimization modeling requires translating natural-language problems into solver-executable formulations, and small models are limited by noisy data and one-shot inference. OptiMind distills class-specific hints to repair ambiguous problems and generate reliable training data, then uses multi-turn reinforcement learning with solver feedback to teach models to revise formulations. The 20B OptiMind-RL model outperforms strong open-source baselines and reaches frontier-model performance on three cleaned benchmarks; the authors attribute the gains to hint libraries and multi-turn learning.
cards.summary: 数学优化建模需要将自然语言问题转化为求解器可执行的公式，小模型在此任务上受噪声数据和一次性推理限制。OptiMind 通过提炼类别提示修复模糊问题、生成可靠训练数据，并用多轮强化学习让模型根据求解器反馈修正公式。实验显示 20B 模型在清洗后的三个基准上优于强开源基线，达到前沿模型性能；作者将性能提升归因于提示库与多轮学习。
keyPointsEn: OptiMind distills recurring formulation errors into class-specific hints to repair ambiguous problems and generate reliable training data.
It uses solver feedback for multi-turn reinforcement learning, training models to iteratively revise formulations at inference time.
The 20B OptiMind-RL outperforms strong open-source baselines and reaches frontier-model performance on three cleaned benchmarks.
The hint library, cleaned test data, cleaning logs, and evaluation code are public, and the trained model is released on Hugging Face.
cards.limitations: 证据来自作者在三个经清洗的文献基准上的评测，未覆盖其他任务或真实部署场景；提示库与多轮学习对性能提升的贡献未在摘要中量化分离；模型为 20B 规模，更小模型是否同样有效尚不明确；公开材料限于提示库、测试数据、日志、代码和训练模型，训练数据全貌与可复现性边界需参考原文。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Many deployments require locally run small models due to privacy, latency, and cost constraints. OptiMind shows that small models can approach frontier-model performance on optimization modeling through hint guidance and multi-turn learning, potentially reducing reliance on large remote models.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from the authors' evaluation on three cleaned literature benchmarks, not other tasks or real deployment settings; the separate contributions of hint libraries and multi-turn learning are not quantified in the abstract; whether smaller models benefit similarly is unclear; public materials are limited to the hint library, test data, logs, code, and trained model, so the full training data and reproducibility boundaries require consulting the paper.
cards.descriptionEn: To address noisy data, ambiguous benchmarks, and one-shot inference limiting small language models in optimization modeling, OptiMind combines data cleaning, class-specific hints, and solver-feedback training; its 20B model reaches frontier-model performance on cleaned benchmarks, with hint library and model publicly released.
cards.description: 针对小语言模型在优化建模中受噪声数据、模糊基准和一次性推理限制的问题，OptiMind 结合数据清洗、类别提示与求解器反馈训练，使 20B 模型在清洗后基准上达到前沿模型水平，并公开提示库与模型。
cards.whyItMatters: 许多实际部署因隐私、延迟和成本约束需要本地运行的小模型。OptiMind 表明，通过提示引导和多轮学习，小模型可在优化建模任务上接近前沿模型，有助于降低对大型远程模型的依赖。
cards.title: OptiMind：用提示库与多轮强化学习提升小模型优化建模能力
keyPoints: OptiMind 将反复出现的建模错误提炼为类别提示，用于修复模糊问题并生成可靠训练数据。
利用求解器反馈进行多轮强化学习，训练模型在推理时根据反馈迭代修正公式。
20B 的 OptiMind-RL 在清洗后的三个基准上优于强开源基线，达到前沿模型性能。
提示库、清洗后测试数据、清洗日志和评估代码已公开，训练模型也在 Hugging Face 发布。

cards.originalTitle: IFRS Compliance Verification: An Open Multi-LLM Benchmark and Content-Conditioned Ensemble Classifier
cards.titleEn: Multi-LLM Benchmark and Content-Conditioned Ensemble Classifier for IFRS Compliance Verification
cards.summaryEn: The authors constructed a multi-LLM benchmark of 19,998 IFRS regulation-disclosure pairs, comprising 11,161 unanimous multi-LLM labels and 8,837 human-annotated disagreement items. They propose a three-stage domain-adapted sentence embedding pipeline and a TPE-optimized gradient-boosted tree ensemble that fuses frozen embeddings with probability features from GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4, and Gemini 2.5 Pro. On the disagreement set, the ensemble achieves 81.7% weighted F1, exceeding the strongest single LLM by 10.4 points and majority voting by 14.6 points, and outperforms eleven unsupervised aggregation baselines; retrieval Recall@15 is 45.3%.
cards.summary: 作者构建了含19,998个IFRS监管-披露对的多LLM基准，其中11,161条为多模型一致标签，8,837条为人类标注的分歧项。作者提出三阶段领域自适应句子嵌入与基于TPE优化的梯度提升树集成分类器，融合冻结嵌入和GPT-4.1、Claude Sonnet 4、Gemini 2.5 Pro的概率特征。在分歧集上集成模型加权F1达81.7%，超过最强单LLM 10.4点、多数投票14.6点，并优于十一种无监督聚合基线；检索管道Recall@15为45.3%。
keyPointsEn: The benchmark contains 19,998 IFRS regulation-disclosure pairs, including 8,837 human-annotated LLM disagreement items.
The ensemble classifier achieves 81.7% weighted F1 on the disagreement set, 10.4 points above the strongest single LLM and 14.6 points above majority voting.
The retrieval pipeline attains Recall@15 of 45.3% on unseen regulations, and the ensemble outperforms eleven unsupervised aggregation baselines.
cards.limitations: 结论基于作者构建的特定标注集，人类标注仅覆盖LLM分歧项，一致标签由多LLM共识形成而非人工全量核验；81.7%加权F1与45.3%召回率表明离高 stakes 自动化仍有距离；数据集与模型尚未公开，跨监管、跨语言泛化性未经验证。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides a reproducible multi-LLM benchmark and an ensemble method that mitigates systematic single-model bias for high-stakes IFRS compliance verification; public release of data and models could support rigorous evaluation of future audit-assistance tools.
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions rest on a specific annotated set built by the authors, where human annotation covers only LLM disagreement items while unanimous labels derive from multi-LLM consensus rather than full human verification; 81.7% weighted F1 and 45.3% recall indicate a remaining gap to high-stakes automation; the dataset and models are not yet public, and cross-regulation or cross-lingual generalization is unverified.
cards.descriptionEn: The study builds a 19,998-pair IFRS disclosure benchmark and a learned ensemble classifier fusing embeddings and LLM probability features; its novelty lies in mitigating single-model bias via learned aggregation, achieving 10.4 points higher weighted F1 than the strongest single LLM on the disagreement set.
cards.description: 该研究构建了19,998个IFRS披露对基准，并提出融合嵌入与LLM概率特征的集成分类器；新在于用学习式集成缓解单模型偏差，在分歧集上加权F1比最强单模型高10.4点。
cards.whyItMatters: 为高风险IFRS合规核验提供了可复现的多LLM基准与缓解单模型系统偏差的集成方法，若数据集与模型公开，可支撑后续审计辅助工具的严谨评测。
cards.title: 多LLM合规验证基准与内容条件集成分类器
keyPoints: 基准含19,998个IFRS监管-披露对，其中8,837条为人类标注的LLM分歧项。
集成分类器在分歧集上加权F1为81.7%，较最强单LLM高10.4点，较多数投票高14.6点。
检索管道在未见监管上Recall@15为45.3%，集成优于十一种无监督聚合基线。

cards.originalTitle: Deceleration without identification: testing a power-law trend in Bitcoin prices under persistent noise
cards.titleEn: Testing a Power-Law Trend in Bitcoin Prices under Persistent Noise
cards.summaryEn: The authors first bound what fifteen years of weekly Bitcoin prices can reveal under persistent noise, then test only answerable questions. Within a declared family of persistent deviations (with a four-year cycle and declining volatility), constant drift is rejected at nominal 5%, while a log-age coefficient of 5.7 (close to the published exponent) is not rejected. The rejection does not survive allowing persistence beyond a random walk, and a Gompertz curve with a ceiling fits about as well as the power law.
cards.summary: 作者先界定十五年周度比特币价格数据在持续噪声下能揭示的范围，再仅检验可回答的问题。在预设的持续偏差族（含四年周期与波动率下降）中，恒定漂移在名义5%水平被拒绝，而对数年龄系数5.7（接近已发表指数）未被拒绝。但若允许比随机游走更强的持续性，拒绝不再成立；带天花板的Gompertz曲线拟合效果与幂律相近。
keyPointsEn: Regressions on time can find trends and high R² where none exist when deviations are as persistent as a random walk
The procedure was fixed, validated and publicly hashed before being applied once
Within the declared family, constant drift is rejected and a log-age coefficient of 5.7 is not rejected
The rejection does not survive allowing persistence beyond a random walk
A Gompertz curve with a ceiling fits about as well as the power law
cards.limitations: 结论受限于十五年周度价格与所声明的持续偏差族（含四年周期和波动率下降）；是否允许比随机游走更强的持续性会改变拒绝结果。偏差是否回归趋势无法判定，幂律与Gompertz曲线难以区分，2027—2030年预测尚待未来价格评分。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It reminds quantitative researchers that goodness of fit alone does not establish a power-law trend, especially under persistent noise. Its preregistered-style design and explicit identification boundary offer a more rigorous methodological reference for evaluating long-run Bitcoin trend claims.
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are limited to fifteen years of weekly prices and the declared persistent-deviation family (four-year cycle, declining volatility); allowing persistence beyond a random walk changes the rejection. Whether deviations revert to trend cannot be decided, the power law and Gompertz curve are hard to distinguish, and 2027–2030 forecasts await future price scoring.
cards.descriptionEn: The study notes that power-law fits can produce spurious trends and high R² when deviations are as persistent as a random walk, and it bounds what fifteen years of weekly prices can answer. Its value lies in a pre-fixed, validated, publicly hashed procedure that separates testable drift forms from an unidentifiable mean-reversion question.
cards.description: 该研究指出现有幂律拟合在偏差呈随机游走式持续时容易产生虚假趋势与高R²，并据此对十五年周度价格能回答的问题设定边界。其价值在于用预先固定、验证并公开哈希的检验流程，区分可检验的漂移形式与不可识别的均值回归问题。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究提醒量化研究者：趋势拟合优度本身不足以证明幂律趋势存在，尤其在持续噪声下。其预注册式检验设计与对可识别边界的界定，为评估比特币长期趋势主张提供了更严谨的方法参照。
cards.title: 比特币价格幂律趋势在持续噪声下的检验
keyPoints: 在偏差呈随机游走式持续时，对时间的回归可能发现不存在的趋势并给出高R²
检验流程在应用前固定、验证并公开哈希，只运行一次
在声明族内恒定漂移被拒绝，对数年龄系数5.7未被拒绝
允许超出随机游走的持续性后，拒绝结论不再成立
带天花板的Gompertz曲线与幂律拟合相当

cards.originalTitle: AFNO: Universal Certifiably-Arbitrage-Free Operator Learning Framework for European Call-Price Surfaces
cards.titleEn: Novel Neural Operator Framework Certifiably Arbitrage-Free for Option Price Surfaces
cards.summaryEn: Neural operators can rapidly approximate solutions to problem families, but standard architectures cannot guarantee static no-arbitrage for predicted European call-price surfaces. The authors propose the AFNO framework, which provably outputs arbitrage-free surfaces, and prove that a nearest arbitrage-free correction of an unconstrained prediction need not exist, and that standard neural operators admit parameter configurations violating no-arbitrage. Thus, out-of-the-box neural operators generally cannot be restricted to arbitrage-free configurations via post-processing, but only guided through PINN-type regularization.
cards.summary: 神经算子能快速近似求解问题族，但标准架构无法保证预测的欧式看涨期权价格曲面满足静态无套利。作者提出 AFNO 框架，可证明地输出无套利曲面，并证明对无约束预测进行最近无套利修正通常不存在，且标准神经算子存在违反无套利的参数配置。因此，即用型神经算子一般不能通过后处理恢复无套利，只能通过 PINN 型正则化引导。
keyPointsEn: AFNO is a certifiably arbitrage-free and universal encoder-decoder neural operator framework that outputs convex combinations of arbitrage-free price surfaces by continuously solving an approximate nearest-neighbor problem.
The authors prove that a nearest arbitrage-free correction of an unconstrained prediction need not exist, implying no-arbitrage cannot, in general, be restored through post-processing.

Standard neural operators (such as FNO and certain encoder-decoder NOs) admit parameter configurations whose outputs violate static no-arbitrage, so out-of-the-box NOs cannot be certifiably restricted to arbitrage-free configurations.
cards.limitations: 本文主要基于理论分析和实验验证，未提及在真实市场数据上的广泛测试；AFNO 的通用性依赖于输入空间为再生核希尔伯特空间，实际应用中的计算成本和近似误差需进一步评估；结论仅针对静态无套利，未涉及动态无套利或其他资产类别。
cards.whyItMattersEn: In quantitative finance, the no-arbitrage property of option price surfaces is crucial for pricing and risk management; AFNO provides a neural operator that provably satisfies no-arbitrage, avoiding negative PnL in downstream trading tasks and offering theoretical guidance for designing reliable financial prediction models.
cards.limitationsEn: The paper is primarily based on theoretical analysis and experimental verification, without extensive testing on real market data; the universality of AFNO relies on the input space being a reproducing kernel Hilbert space, and practical computational cost and approximation errors need further evaluation; conclusions are limited to static no-arbitrage and do not address dynamic no-arbitrage or other asset classes.
cards.descriptionEn: Existing neural operators cannot guarantee static no-arbitrage when predicting European call-price surfaces and may yield negative PnL; this paper introduces a certifiably arbitrage-free and universal encoder-decoder neural operator framework that maps inputs to convex combinations of arbitrage-free price surfaces via continuously solving an approximate nearest-neighbor problem.
cards.description: 现有神经算子在预测欧式看涨期权价格曲面时无法保证静态无套利，可能产生负盈亏；本文提出一个可证明无套利且通用的编码器-解码器神经算子框架，通过连续求解近似最近邻问题，将输入映射为无套利价格曲面的凸组合。
cards.whyItMatters: 在量化金融中，期权价格曲面的无套利性质对定价和风险管理至关重要；AFNO 提供了可证明满足无套利的神经算子，避免下游交易任务中的负盈亏，并为设计可靠金融预测模型提供理论依据。
cards.title: 新型神经算子框架可证明无套利期权价格曲面
keyPoints: AFNO 是一个可证明无套利且通用的编码器-解码器神经算子框架，通过连续求解近似最近邻问题输出无套利价格曲面的凸组合。
作者证明无约束预测的最近无套利修正通常不存在，意味着后处理一般无法恢复无套利。
标准神经算子（如 FNO 和某些编码器-解码器 NO）存在参数配置使输出违反静态无套利，即用型 NO 不能保证无套利。

cards.originalTitle: Have wind and solar energy increased electricity price volatility? And what is electricity price volatility, anyway?
cards.titleEn: Wind, Solar, and Electricity Price Volatility: A New Framework Distinguishing Variability from Volatility
cards.summaryEn: The paper distinguishes two types of electricity price variation: variability, the price dispersion across delivery periods within the same day-ahead auction, and volatility, the price changes for the same delivery period in subsequent trading. Using 25 years of German data, variability follows a U-shaped trajectory while volatility declines over time. The author attributes variability to non-storability and volatility to uncertainty, and re-examines the impact of rising wind and solar shares.
cards.summary: 论文区分了电力价格中两种不同的变动：同一拍卖中不同交付时段的价格离散（变异性），以及拍卖后交易中同一交付时段的价格变化（波动性）。基于德国25年数据，变异性呈U型轨迹，而波动性随时间下降。作者认为变异性源于非储存性，波动性源于不确定性，并据此重新审视风光占比上升的影响。
keyPointsEn: Provides formal definitions: variability is price dispersion across delivery periods in the day-ahead auction; volatility is price changes for the same delivery period after the auction.
German evidence shows that as wind and solar shares rose from zero to nearly 50%, variability first fell then rose (U-shaped), while volatility steadily declined.
Across 24 European bidding zones, variability has increased in most zones since the late 2010s and correlates positively with solar share.
cards.limitations: 结论主要基于德国历史数据与24个欧洲竞价区的描述性证据，未建立严格因果识别；模型为简单代数模型，可能遗漏市场力、政策变化等混杂因素；波动性度量依赖不平衡价格与日内交易数据，样本与市场范围有限。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Offers a clearer measurement framework for assessing the impact of wind and solar on electricity prices, avoiding misreading price dispersion across delivery periods as price fluctuations during trading; relevant for electricity market design and policy discussion.
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions rely mainly on German historical data and descriptive evidence from 24 European bidding zones, without strict causal identification; the simple algebraic model may omit confounding factors such as market power and policy changes; volatility measures depend on imbalance prices and intraday transaction data, with limited sample and market scope.
cards.descriptionEn: The paper argues that the literature conflates price dispersion across delivery times (variability) with price changes across trading times (volatility), and finds a U-shaped variability but declining volatility in Germany over 25 years.
cards.description: 本文指出文献混淆了交付时间间的价格离散（变异性）与交易时间间的价格变化（波动性），并基于德国25年数据发现变异性呈U型而波动性下降。
cards.whyItMatters: 为评估风光对电价的影响提供了更清晰的度量框架，避免将交付时段间的价格离散误读为交易过程中的价格波动；对电力市场设计与政策讨论有参考价值。
cards.title: 风电光伏与电价波动：区分变异性与波动性的新框架
keyPoints: 提出变异性与波动性的形式化定义：变异性是同一日前拍卖中不同交付时段的价格离散，波动性是拍卖后同一交付时段的价格变化。
德国经验显示，风光占比从零升至近50%期间，变异性先降后升呈U型，而波动性持续下降。
在24个欧洲竞价区，2010年代末以来多数区域变异性上升，且与光伏占比正相关。

cards.originalTitle: Deep Learning for Operator Maps in Optimal Liquidation
cards.titleEn: Deep Learning for Operator Maps in Optimal Liquidation
cards.summaryEn: Fact: Under a general transient impact kernel, the optimal trading strategy is locally Lipschitz continuous with respect to temporary and transient impact parameters and the fundamental price process. Authors' view: this continuity justifies neural-network approximation of the strategy map with model parameters as inputs. Fact: the paper proposes sampling, finite-dimensional projection, and inventory-trade-signal-based dimensionality reduction for the transient impact kernel, and numerically demonstrates the effectiveness of the trained network and quantifies potential financial costs of kernel misspecification.
cards.summary: 事实：在一般瞬态冲击核下，最优交易策略关于临时与瞬态冲击参数及基础价格过程是局部Lipschitz连续的。作者观点：这种连续性 justifies 使用神经网络逼近以模型参数为输入的策略映射。事实：论文提出瞬态冲击核的采样、有限维投影及基于库存-交易信号关系的降维方法，并数值展示训练后网络的有效性，用于量化瞬态冲击核误设的潜在财务成本。
keyPointsEn: The optimal trading strategy is locally Lipschitz continuous with respect to temporary impact, transient impact parameters, and the fundamental price process.
Training data are generated via kernel sampling and finite-dimensional projection, with dimensionality reduction based on the inventory-trade signal relationship.
The trained neural network is used to quantify potential financial costs of misspecifying the transient impact kernel.
cards.limitations: 证据限于所分析的最优执行模型及Abi Jaber和Neuman给出的策略结构；数值实验的具体设定、样本范围与误差界需参见原文；误设成本的量化依赖于所考虑的核扰动与训练数据生成方式，外推至其他市场或冲击机制需谨慎。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides continuity-based theoretical support for neural-network approximation of parameter-to-strategy maps and offers concrete sampling and dimensionality-reduction schemes for transient impact kernel inputs, helping assess robustness and potential costs of execution strategies under parameter uncertainty or kernel misspecification.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is confined to the analyzed optimal execution model and the strategy structure derived by Abi Jaber and Neuman; numerical settings, sample ranges, and error bounds require consulting the original paper; the quantified misspecification cost depends on the considered kernel perturbations and training-data generation, so extrapolation to other markets or impact mechanisms requires caution.
cards.descriptionEn: The study proves local Lipschitz continuity of the optimal liquidation strategy with respect to temporary and transient impact parameters and the fundamental price process, providing a theoretical basis for neural-network approximation with model parameters as inputs. It also proposes methods to sample and project the transient impact kernel for training-data generation and uses the inventory-trade signal relationship for dimensionality reduction.
cards.description: 该研究证明最优清算策略对临时与瞬态价格冲击参数及基础价格过程具有局部Lipschitz连续性，从而为以模型参数为输入的神经网络逼近提供理论依据；并提出瞬态冲击核的采样与投影方法，用于生成训练数据，同时利用库存与交易信号关系降维。
cards.whyItMatters: 为基于神经网络的参数到策略映射近似提供连续性理论支撑，并给出处理瞬态冲击核输入的具体降维与采样方案，有助于在模型参数不确定或核误设时评估执行策略的稳健性与潜在成本。
cards.title: 深度学习逼近最优清算中的算子映射
keyPoints: 最优交易策略对临时冲击、瞬态冲击参数及基础价格过程局部Lipschitz连续。
利用核采样与有限维投影生成训练数据，并用库存-交易信号关系降维。
训练后的神经网络被用于量化瞬态冲击核误设的潜在财务成本。

cards.originalTitle: Tabular Foundation Models in Financial Predictions
cards.titleEn: Evaluating Tabular Foundation Models for Financial Forecasting
cards.summaryEn: Fact: The study compares Google Research's TabFM with a fine-tuned open-weight LLM from recent accounting research and several tree-based models on predicting next-year earnings changes; TabFM is more accurate than all comparison models and faster and less computationally intensive than the LLM. Fact: Several tree-based specifications produce predictions more quickly than TabFM, so choosing between them involves a trade-off between accuracy and speed. Author's view: TFMs have promise as a new forecasting tool in accounting and finance, but the evaluation is based on a single benchmark task, and no class of models is likely to dominate in all settings.
cards.summary: 事实：研究比较了 Google Research 的 TabFM、一个在近期会计研究中微调的开源大语言模型以及若干树模型，在预测企业下一年盈余变化的任务上，TabFM 的准确率最高，且比大语言模型更快、计算强度更低。事实：部分树模型预测速度快于 TabFM，因此模型选择涉及准确性与速度的权衡。作者观点：TFM 有望成为会计与金融预测的新工具，但评估仅基于单一基准任务，没有哪类模型可能在所有场景中占优。
keyPointsEn: TabFM is more accurate than a fine-tuned LLM and several tree-based models on the benchmark task of predicting next-year earnings changes.
TabFM learns in context without post-release training or tuning and avoids look-ahead bias because it is pretrained on synthetic tabular data.
Some tree-based models predict faster than TabFM, so practical model choice involves an accuracy-speed trade-off.
cards.limitations: 评估仅基于单一基准任务（预测企业下一年盈余变化），结论不能推广到其他预测场景。没有哪类模型可能在所有设置中占优。研究未覆盖 TFM 在其他会计或金融任务上的表现，也未讨论模型在不同样本、时期或市场条件下的稳健性。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study offers a new, easy-to-use forecasting tool for accounting and finance that requires no additional training and avoids look-ahead bias. Its benchmark shows TFM's accuracy advantage while revealing a speed disadvantage relative to some tree models, helping researchers choose models based on accuracy versus efficiency priorities in practical forecasting tasks.
cards.limitationsEn: The evaluation is based on a single benchmark task (predicting firms' next-year earnings changes), so conclusions may not generalize to other forecasting settings. No class of models is likely to dominate in all settings. The study does not cover TFM performance on other accounting or finance tasks, nor does it discuss robustness across different samples, periods, or market conditions.
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces tabular foundation models (TFMs) to accounting research and evaluates their performance on a common benchmark task: predicting firms' next-year earnings changes. TFMs produce numeric predictions and learn in context without post-release training or tuning. They are pretrained on synthetic tabular data, avoiding look-ahead bias from memorizing firms' outcomes. Compared with a fine-tuned open-weight large language model and several tree-based models, TabFM
cards.description: 该研究首次将表格基础模型（TFM）引入会计研究，并在预测企业下一年盈余变化这一基准任务上评估其性能。TFM 无需发布后训练或调参即可在上下文中学习，且预训练数据为合成表格数据，避免了对企业实际结果的记忆而导致的未来信息偏差。与微调的开源大语言模型及多种树模型相比，TabFM 预测更准确且计算效率更高，但部分树模型速度更快，选择时需权衡准确性与速度。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为会计与金融预测提供了一种无需额外训练、易于使用且能规避未来信息偏差的新工具选项。其基准测试表明 TFM 在准确性上具有优势，同时揭示了与树模型相比的速度劣势，有助于研究者在实际预测任务中根据准确性与效率的优先级做出模型选择。
cards.title: 表格基础模型在财务预测中的表现评估
keyPoints: TabFM 在预测企业下一年盈余变化的基准任务上准确率高于微调大语言模型和多个树模型。
TabFM 无需发布后训练或调参，可直接在上下文中学习，且因预训练于合成表格数据而避免未来信息偏差。
部分树模型预测速度快于 TabFM，实际选择需在准确性与速度间权衡。

cards.titleEn: Rule 605 Reports: Stability and Predictive Limits of Order Probability Laws
cards.summaryEn: The paper analyzes monthly Rule 605 reports from Virtu and SoHo from January 2021 to March 2024, covering distributions of 16 datasets generated from 26 stock-trading parameters. The fact is that linear regression and LSTM show poor predictive power for order probability laws, although the laws themselves are relatively stable. The author's view is that month-to-month correlations are highly stable and predictable, which may be a more reliable modeling entry point.
cards.summary: 论文分析了Virtu和SoHo两家公司2021年1月至2024年3月的月度规则605报告，涵盖26个股票交易参数生成的16个数据集分布。事实是线性回归和LSTM对订单概率律的预测能力较差，尽管概率律本身相对稳定。作者观点认为月间相关性高度稳定且可预测，这可能是更可靠的建模切入点。
keyPointsEn: The study is based on monthly Rule 605 reports from Virtu and SoHo from January 2021 to March 2024, involving distributions of 16 datasets from 26 trading parameters.
Linear regression and LSTM perform poorly in predicting stock order probability laws, but the laws themselves are relatively stable.
Month-to-month correlations of order probability laws are highly stable and predictable, suggesting standard prediction methods may not suit such regulatory report data.
cards.limitations: 研究仅基于两家公司（Virtu和SoHo）在2021年1月至2024年3月的数据，样本有限且时间跨度较短，结论的普适性需进一步验证；未涉及其他市场或监管环境。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Rule 605 reports are publicly available regulatory data, and understanding their statistical properties has reference value for market microstructure research and trading cost analysis. The study notes limited effectiveness of standard prediction methods but stable month-to-month correlations, which may guide the development of more appropriate analytical tools.
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based only on two companies (Virtu and SoHo) from January 2021 to March 2024, with a limited sample and short time span, so generalizability needs further validation; other markets or regulatory environments are not covered.
cards.descriptionEn: The study analyzes monthly Rule 605 reports from Virtu and SoHo between January 2021 and March 2024, finding that linear regression and LSTM have poor predictive power for stock order probability laws, despite the laws being relatively stable. The novelty lies in revealing the limitations of standard prediction methods on regulatory report data, and its usefulness is in offering a new perspective on the dynamics of order probability laws.
cards.description: 该研究分析Virtu与SoHo在2021年1月至2024年3月提交的规则605月度报告，发现股票订单概率律的线性回归与LSTM预测能力较差，但订单概率律的月间相关性高度稳定且可预测。新在于揭示了标准预测方法在监管报告数据上的局限性，有用在于为理解订单概率律的动态提供了新视角。
cards.whyItMatters: 规则605报告是监管要求的公开数据，理解其统计特性对市场微观结构研究和交易成本分析有参考价值。研究指出标准预测方法效果有限，但月间相关性稳定，可能为开发更合适的分析工具提供方向。
cards.title: 规则605报告：订单概率律的稳定性与预测局限
keyPoints: 研究基于Virtu和SoHo在2021年1月至2024年3月的规则605月度报告，涉及26个交易参数产生的16个数据集分布。
线性回归和LSTM对股票订单概率律的预测表现较差，但概率律本身相对稳定。
订单概率律的月间相关性高度稳定且可预测，提示标准预测方法可能不适用于此类监管报告数据。

cards.titleEn: Quant Links Digest: Modified Gerber Statistic for Portfolio Optimization
cards.summaryEn: The source is a Quantocracy roundup page listing recently featured external quant blog posts with short blurbs. The lead item revisits the Gerber statistic, a measure of co-movement introduced by Gerber et al., and points to a follow-up post on a modified Gerber statistic. The source itself is an index and paraphrase; it provides no new data, code, or validation results.

keyPointsEn: The source is a link aggregator: its content consists of titles and brief paraphrases of external posts, not an independent research paper.
The lead item centers on the Gerber statistic as a co-movement measure and points to Portfolio Optimizer's discussion of a modified version.
No formulas, parameter settings, or empirical comparisons for the modification are given; information stops at the indexing level.
cards.limitations: 本卡片仅基于链接汇总页的描述生成，未包含被链接博文的方法、数据与结论，因此不能作为评估修正 Gerber 统计量有效性的依据。来源为二手索引，发布日期与链接内容的时效性、可访问性均无法在此确认。任何关于该统计量优于既有协方差估计的说法均需回到原文验证。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For quant researchers, the source serves as an entry point for tracking improvements to co-movement measures in portfolio optimization and for locating the original discussion of the Gerber statistic and its modified form, though methods and evidence strength must be verified in the source posts.
cards.limitationsEn: This card is generated only from the description on the link roundup page and does not include the methods, data, or conclusions of the linked posts, so it cannot support an assessment of the modified Gerber statistic's effectiveness. It is a secondary index, and the timeliness and accessibility of the dated links cannot be confirmed here. Any claim that this statistic outperforms existing covariance estimators must be checked against the original text.
